mostWorthwhile.text: Making charcoal in the kiln was worthwhile because the explanation showed how limiting air changes what happens to heated wood.

leastWorthwhile.text: The puppet felt least relevant while I was trying to make bellows, and it left the recipe unclear.

surprise.text: Using stone at the iron quarry produced iron ore; I had expected a clue or material for a pickaxe instead.

arbitrary.text: Cloth and air produced bellows with wooden boards, a valve and a nozzle, even though those parts were not explicit in the combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the forge and charcoal steps made the process understandable, and I am curious how the tools will be used.
